title: Reverse a Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list represented as space-separated integers, reverse the list and output the reversed values.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` node values.
hints: Iterative solution maintains `prev = None` and `curr = head`.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = data[1:1+n]
    print(' '.join(reversed(vals)))
else:
    print('')
